# Intelligence Quiotent

> Intelligence Quiotent is an assessment and learner-management platform for schools, colleges, and corporate training teams. Institutions create tests, see what each learner knows, and assign the revision they need next.

Intelligence Quiotent is one web platform with two connected halves: assessment and learning. Teachers build tests from a reusable question bank, run them online or on paper, and get graded results in minutes. They then organise courses, batches, and learners, and assign revision from those results.

The AI suggests adaptive practice, step-by-step hints, draft questions, and feedback on written answers. Teachers review and approve what it creates. Learner data is not used to train third-party models. Final grading stays with the institution.

It is for schools (unit tests, term exams, report cards), colleges and coaching centres (question banks, mock tests, batch analytics), and corporate training (skill certification, completion tracking, manager reports).

Office: Aishwarya Colony, Venkata Rathinam Nagar, Adyar, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600020, India.
Email: info@intelliquiotent.com
The team replies within one working day. A demo is a 30-minute walkthrough tailored to the institution's curriculum.

## FAQ

### What is Intelligence Quiotent?

Intelligence Quiotent is an assessment and learner-management platform. Schools, colleges, and training teams create tests, track every learner's progress, and assign the right revision from one place.

### Who is Intelligence Quiotent for?

It is built for schools, for colleges and coaching centres, and for corporate training teams that need to certify skills and report completion.

### How does assessment connect to learning?

Teachers run a test from a question bank, online or on paper. They see mastery by topic for every learner and every batch, assign revision to the learners who need it, and measure again.

### Does the AI replace teachers?

No. The AI suggests practice, hints, questions, and feedback from each learner's results. Teachers review and approve everything it creates. Final grading stays with the institution.

### Can tests be taken on paper?

Yes. Tests run online or on paper. Objective questions can be auto-graded, and written answers can use rubrics with suggested scores for a teacher to approve.

### How do I contact Intelligence Quiotent?

Email info@intelliquiotent.com or use the contact page. The team replies within one working day. The office is at Aishwarya Colony, Venkata Rathinam Nagar, Adyar, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600020.
